implementation.memory: reserve creates or takes over a lease; commit and release require the exact generation and token
implementation.postgres: migration 0025 adds generation/token state, backfills legacy reserved rows, and enforces fencing constraints
implementation.preflight: startup requires lease_generation, lease_token and both fencing constraints
implementation.claim: claim carries one reservation through commit and releases only that same reservation after commit failure
implementation.http: signature verification remains before reserve/claim and downstream failures release the current reservation

controls.case: an in-memory stale holder cannot commit or release a successor lease
PostgreSQL takeover increments generation and changes the opaque token
PostgreSQL stale commit/release cannot mutate the successor and the successor can commit
migration and preflight require the complete fencing catalog
committed replay remains retained and cannot be released by a stale reservation
